method: Questions were researched with an evidence-only retrieval tool over one corpus of open-access and public-domain texts (see corpus.json). Each excerpt was checked word for word against the corpus passage it cites when this file was written; corpus_chunk numbers that passage in the corpus snapshot of 2026-10-02.
questions: What do the openly excerpted Sagan tools contribute, and how do expertise and support structure qualify their use?

evidence.excerpt: Through their training, scientists are equipped with what Sagan calls a “baloney detection kit” — a set of cognitive tools and techniques that fortify the mind against penetration by falsehoods: The kit is brought out as a matter of course whenever new ideas are offered for consideration.
By adopting the kit, we can all shield ourselves against clueless guile and deliberate manipulation.
Try not to get overly attached to a hypothesis just because it’s yours.
This convenient rule-of-thumb urges us when faced with two hypotheses that explain the data equally well to choose the simpler.

evidence.excerpt: Standardizing arguments by listing their premises and conclusions is one way to delineate the content of an argument and prepare it for evaluation.
The diagram that follows depicts the relationships between the argument’s key components, using arrows to indicate the inferences it includes.
